title: Apex optimized
description: a good and realiable optimizing pack
body:
*shaders*

Shader Support: Bundled with MakeUp-UltraFast-9.5b and Complementary Reimagined r5.8.1 pre-configured for the ultimate balance between cinematic visuals and high framerates.

🚀 *Performance Enhancement*

Sodium: Rendering & Engine Optimizations: Modern rendering engine replacement that drastically improves frame production, reduces CPU overhead, and optimizes memory usage.

Chunk Generation: Smoother chunk loading and world generation algorithms to reduce stuttering and "lag spikes" while exploring.

Logic & AI Tuning: Optimized entity tracking, item stacking, and background server-thread calculations.

Memory Management: Upgraded data structures and memory leak fixes to prevent garbage collection stutter.

🛠️ *Utility Features*


​Dynamic Lighting: Torches, lanterns, and other light-emitting items illuminate your surroundings dynamically when held in your hand or dropped.

​Enhanced HUD & UI: Clean, scannable user interface tweaks providing detailed item descriptions, durability overlays, and tooltips.

Zoomify Functionality: Highly customizable cinematic spyglass zoom hotkey for scanning the terrain. use the C key to zoom
